subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Three Amigos Meetings
description: A short lesson to help you apply Three Amigos Meetings.

hook.text: A story is 'ready' for sprint. Development starts. Halfway through, everyone realizes they meant different things.

buildup.text: Misunderstandings between product, development, and testing cause the most expensive rework.

discovery.text: Three Amigos brings one developer, one tester, and one product person together to discuss each story.

twist.text: The meeting isn't about answers. It's about surfacing different perspectives before work begins.

climax.text: Fifteen minutes of Three Amigos prevents two days of rework from a misunderstood acceptance criterion.

punchline.text: Three perspectives, fifteen minutes, zero surprises.

quiz.question: What is the goal of a Three Amigos meeting?
options: Surface different perspectives on a story before work starts
